snippet.title: State of Go 2020: changes since Go 1.12
snippet.description:
Slides: bit.ly/sog-fosdem20

Francesc Campoy (https://twitter.com/francesc) and Maartje Eyskens (https://twitter.com/MaartjeME) come back to FOSDEM to cover the most important changes to the community since the same talk in 2019.

We cover the most important changes since Go 1.12 regarding:

- the language
- the standard library
- the tooling
- the runtime
- the community

snippet.title: ChromeGoDoc: a simple Chrome extension
snippet.description:
This video demonstrates the usage of the ChromeGoDoc extensions.

When visiting a github.com or code.google.com page a gopher icon appears on the address bar. Clicking the icon opens the corresponding godoc.org page.
